threshold.text: Mist listens before route decisions emerge.

fog.text: Fog and chamber drift into gentle orientation.

storm.text: Fog threads the edge of pressure.

threshold.text: Shimmer amplifies what the threshold can hold.

fog.text: Light clarifies the mist without forcing certainty.

storm.text: Shimmer bends against pressure and finds form.

threshold.text: Pressure tests every edge of the threshold.

fog.text: Storm tears open hidden weather channels.
Soil receives mist and stores signal.

shimmer.text: Roots lift light into steady growth.

storm.text: Soil absorbs pressure and keeps form.

threshold.text: The root machine listens for the next branch.
